children.name: title
children.label: Story title
children.default: A familiar door. A personal place.

children.name: standfirst
children.label: Short introduction
children.default: Every community has a story. Share how people, familiar places and personal choices shaped yours.

name: introduction
label: Story introduction
default: Start with the people who call this community home. What matters to them? What feels familiar? Use their own experiences, with permission, to introduce the story.

default.title: Start with the person.
default.content: Describe how residents and the people close to them helped choose their door designs. Share personal preferences rather than assumptions.

default.title: Making room for individuality.
default.content: Show the details that make each door distinctive. Explain the choices made with this community, alongside photographs of the installed decals.

default.title: Part of everyday life.
default.content: Describe life in the community after installation. Include only observations and outcomes you can substantiate, and distinguish individual experiences from clinical evidence.

children.name: heading
children.label: Heading
children.default: What could feel like home in your community?

children.name: text
children.label: Supporting text
children.default: Let's start with the people who live there.
